_meta._note: Build and validator settings of tools/dungeons. Not balance values (tech note 13.1): rule thresholds that are balance live in config/balance/dungeons.json and are read from there (area, coverageFilter, verification). Every path is relative to the repo root.

area._note: Same projection as tools/coverage (METHOD 5, EPSG:32647) so area_m2 matches candidates.geojson. outOfRange error: published pilot records must sit inside area.minArea_m2..maxArea_m2 (board P2-F04-T26); the back office 'warn' of dungeons.json#area.outOfRangeAction is a drawing aid, not a publish rule.

_note.maxOverlap_m2: Tolerance for floating point slivers only. dungeon-rules.md 2 point B: published dungeons never overlap.
_note.excludedZoneReasons: reason_excluded values of data/coverage/excluded.geojson that mark a zone a dungeon must not overlap (blocklist, religious, D-083 exclusions, private land). area_too_small / area_too_large / nested_in are ordinary parks, and indoor / indoor_market are halls inside a market or park: none of them is a zone.
_note.entranceMaxBoundaryDistance_m: dungeon-rules.md 4 point B: the pinned entrance sits on the real polygon edge. Tolerance for pin placement on imagery; PROPOSED, systems-designer may move it to config/balance.
_note.extraReviewFlagTags: level-designer request (pilot-dungeons.md 2 and 9): building=civic and location=roof need a review. Merged with coverageFilter.reviewFlagTags; handoff asks systems-designer to add them there so point A uses them too.
_note.inheritedCandidateFlags: Flags on the matching candidate (by osm_id) that stay review flags until the record acknowledges them (point B: redraw around the shrine, off the major road).
_note.bounds: [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat] around Bangkok and the five vicinity provinces; a coordinate outside is a data error (swapped lat/lng).
_note.nameKeyMissing: error | warn: a published name_key / search_name_key that is not in config/content/names.th.json.
